semiconductor_relevance: High — Sumitomo (SHI) Cryogenics of Europe GmbH provides essential cryogenic solutions that are integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sumitomo (SHI) Cryogenics of Europe GmbH specializes in innovative cryotechnical solutions, particularly in the semiconductor and optical coating industries. Their products, including the SICERA® cryopump, are designed to meet the increasing demands of semiconductor wafer production and other related applications.
capabilities: SICERA® cryopump for semiconductor wafer production
